ext.description: Debug 1C:Enterprise.Element (XBSL) applications in regular VS Code via the platform's own debug adapter and elemctl.
cmd.setup.title: XBSL: Set up 1C:Element debugging
debugger.label: 1C:Element (XBSL)
attach.appId: Element application id (app-id). Empty: ELEMENT_APP_ID from .env of the sources root is used.
attach.authMode: Authentication mode of the debuggee application (default: regular sign-in).
attach.stopOnEntry: Stop on the first line of every thread. Noisy on a live web application (every server call pauses); prefer breakpoints.
attach.workspace: Sources root: the directory that contains <Vendor>/<Name>/Project.yaml. Empty: detected automatically from the opened folder.
attach.envFile: Path to a .env file with Console API credentials (elemctl --env-file). Empty: .env of the sources root.
config.adapterPath: The platform debug adapter directory - a folder with a `repo` subdirectory holding the adapter's jar files. Leave empty to use the adapter shipped by the elemctl plugin (queried via `elemctl debug-adapter`). Otherwise extracted from the 1C:Element distribution (`.../@1c-appengine-plugin/bin/debugger`); NOT bundled into the vsix (proprietary 1C jars). Example: `C:/tools/xbsl-debug-adapter` (must contain `repo/*.jar`). The "XBSL: Set up 1C:Element debugging" command can fill it.
config.javaPath: Path to the Java executable (JDK 17+). Default: `java` from PATH. Example: `C:/Program Files/Java/jdk-21/bin/java.exe`.
config.elemctlPath: Path to elemctl (>= 0.5, with the `apps debug` and `debug-adapter` commands). Default: `elemctl` from PATH. elemctl reads Console API credentials from the `.env` in the sources root. Example: `C:/Users/me/.local/bin/elemctl.exe`.
config.openApplicationOnStart: Open the debuggee application in the browser when the session starts (with debug session parameters).
config.fixVariablesFilter: Work around the structure-expansion crash on a client frame: add the filter field (named/indexed) to `variables` requests that VS Code sends without one. Without the workaround, expanding a structure/array in the Variables view hangs the debuggee application's JS runtime and drops the session. Keep it on until the platform fixes handling of filter=NONE.
snippet.attach.label: 1C:Element: debug an application (attach)
snippet.attach.description: Attach to an Element application via elemctl + the platform adapter
initial.attach.name: Debug 1C:Element application
